images.note: Real screenshot from Apache Airflow's own official documentation, showing the Airflow web UI: the left navigation (Home, Dags, Assets, Browse, Admin, Docs), a DAG's Overview tab with its run history grid (green/red/orange status cells per task per run), Failed Tasks/Failed Runs counters, and a Last 10 DAG Runs duration chart.

imageNote: Found via a Browser check of airflow.apache.org's rendered img.src values on the official 'UI Overview' documentation page. Confirmed via curl that airflow.apache.org's Sphinx-generated docs are NOT JS-rendered — the image paths are present directly in the raw HTML as relative paths (e.g. '_images/dag_overview_dashboard.png'), resolved against the page's own directory. This site has an unusually rich set of real UI screenshots covering nearly every screen in the product (DAG list, Grid, Graph, Calendar, task logs, XCom, Connections admin, backfill, etc.) — the best-covered course source found so far this catalog.
